description: Get signed upload URLs for files to send to Vibo when this server cannot read your filesystem (a hosted/remote connection). For each file, PUT its bytes to `uploadUrl` with exactly the returned Content-Type (the `curl` field is a ready command), then pass the slot's `blobKey` to vibo_set_profile_photo (`blobKey`) or vibo_answer_question (`imageBlobKeys`/`fileBlobKeys`). Each URL expires in 30 minutes; files over 25 MiB are refused when used. The stored copy is deleted once Vibo accepts it. Uploads nothing to Vibo by itself. Only available on a deployment with a blob store; otherwise send small files inline as base64.

files.description: One entry per file to upload (at most 10).

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot.

mimeType.description: MIME type. Default: inferred from the filename extension. The PUT must send exactly this Content-Type.

name: vibo_upload_slots
